text:
Accepted workspace Plan entry polish from worker df2e6b06.

Integrated changes:
- Pinned workspace action row styling for Plan entry instead of regular closable tab appearance.
- Compact sidebar icon mode.
- Stable data attributes: data-workspace-action="plan" and data-pinned="true".
- Empty-state policy remains: no workspace Plan entry is rendered when no matching plans exist.

Orchestrator verification in hot checkout:
- npx tsx src/components/Canvas/workspacePlanEntry.test.ts: 14/14 passed.
- npx tsx src/components/Canvas/CanvasButton.test.tsx: 2/2 passed.
- npx tsc --noEmit: passed.
- pnpm build: passed.
- npx playwright test --config=tests/playwright/playwright.config.ts --project=golden --grep @workspace-plan-entry --reporter=line --timeout=60000: 1 passed.

Note: first Playwright invocation without line reporter hung until outer alarm; diagnostic rerun passed and is the accepted UI gate.

Final orchestrator correction after user UX review:
- Workspace Plan entry is project-local only; foreign project plans no longer leak into General through owner/assigned pane fallbacks.
- Visible label is stable "Plan"; plan names/counts move to title/metadata, not primary row text.
- Empty/projectless workspaces hide the Plan action.
- Workspace Plan canvas no longer shows Close X; it behaves as a workspace view.
- Clicking the workspace tab row closes the Plan canvas.

Final gates:
- npx tsx src/components/Canvas/workspacePlanEntry.test.ts: 16/16 passed.
- npx tsc --noEmit: passed.
- env CODETERM_API_PORT=7686 ./build.sh check: passed.
- pnpm build: passed.
- npx playwright test --config=tests/playwright/playwright.config.ts --project=golden --grep @workspace-plan-entry --reporter=line --timeout=60000: 1 passed.

Accepted in hot checkout. Current integrated implementation hides empty workspace plan entries, shows pinned Plan action only when workspace has matching non-empty/project-local plans, and routes pane/task focus through workspace canvas. Gates run by orchestrator: npx tsx src/components/Canvas/workspacePlanEntry.test.ts (16/16), npx tsx src/components/Canvas/CanvasButton.test.tsx (2/2), CT_E2E_PORT=7686 npx playwright test --config=tests/playwright/playwright.config.ts --project=golden --grep @workspace-plan-entry (1 passed).
